title: Comfortable 3BR |Minutes to Broadway| Parking
description:
This 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment offers a simple, comfortable stay in a highly convenient Nashville location. Perfect for families, groups, or business travelers, the layout provides privacy, space, and easy access to the city.

The space
Designed with comfort in mind, this apartment sleeps up to 6 guests and offers a welcoming space for both short and extended stays.
	•	Three private bedrooms featuring queen beds
	•	Two full bathrooms for added convenience
	•	Simple, modern décor with a clean feel
	•	Spacious living area perfect for relaxing together

Location Highlights

You’ll be minutes from everything Nashville has to offer:
	•	10–12 minutes to Downtown Nashville and Broadway
	•	5–10 minutes to Vanderbilt University and Vanderbilt Medical Center
	•	Quick access to major hospitals
	•	Close to Midtown, The Gulch, West End, restaurants, shopping, and cafés
	•	Easy access to ride-shares and major roadways

Enjoy Music City without the crowds and noise of staying downtown.

Amenities
	•	Fully equipped kitchen for meals at home
	•	Fast and reliable Wi-Fi
	•	Comfortable common spaces
	•	Well-suited for families, friends, and work travelers

Perfect For

✔️ Nashville getaways
✔️ Families visiting Vanderbilt or hospitals
✔️ Events, concerts, and sports
✔️ Business travelers
✔️ Longer stays

Other things to note
Please note: This apartment is located on the third floor and requires two flights of stairs to access.

Early Check-In Fees
Check-in time is from 4:00pm-1:00am. Additional fees may apply depending on your requested check-in time between 12:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m. A full nightly rate will apply for any check-in before 12:00 p.m.

Late Check-Out Fees 
Check-out time is 10:00 a.m. Additional fees may apply depending on your requested check-out time between 10am and 1pm. A full nightly rate will apply for any check-out after 1:00 p.m. 

All early check-in and late check-out requests must be approved in advance and confirmed in writing by our team, and are subject to availability. 

Parking
We have a parking space available for rent at $5/day. Please let us know before your arrival if you would like to reserve it.

Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the property. A $500 fine will be imposed if smoking is confirmed or if lingering smoke odors are detected.

For Your Safety & Peace of Mind
To help keep our home and all guests safe, we use a secure identity verification service called Truvi. It’s a quick, one-time process that helps ensure everyone who stays with us is verified—protecting you, your reservation, and the property. After you book, you’ll receive a text message from Truvi with a secure link to complete the verification. It only takes a minute and helps us maintain a trusted, safe environment for all guests. Thank you for helping us keep our space welcoming and secure!

By booking this reservation, you consent to receive calls and/or text messages from us and our third-party messaging and calling service regarding your stay, including check-in details, property access, and time-sensitive matters. Please be advised that all phone communications may be recorded for quality assurance, training, and security purposes.

Pet-friendly: $7 per dog per night (maximum of 2), plus a $99 pet cleaning fee.

Guests are required to submit a photo of the dog(s) they will be bringing prior to arrival.

Please note that any damage caused by pets (including chewing on items or defecating on furniture, linens, or other areas) will be subject to additional charges.
